newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 28.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 28.

text.p: * Boeing Co was down 3/8 at 101-5/8 in London. European Union and U.S. officials have begun talks on European complaints about U.S. subsidies to aircraft makers, and Boeing fears the outcome will be linked to an EU decision on its planned takeover of McDonnell Douglas Corp, the Wall Street Journal said. McDonell Douglas closed at 60-1/2 Friday on the New York Stock Exchange.
* International Business Machines Corp was up 1/8 at 150-7/8 in London ahead of its annual meeting Tuesday. Dealers said shareholders hope IBM will announce a more aggressive stock buyback plan.
* Tobacco stocks were mostly a bit higher in London after sliding in New York Friday amid fears the industry may have to cough up more money if there is a negotiated settlement of U.S. lawsuits.
Philip Morris Cos Inc was up 1/8 at 39-1/2 while RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp rose 1/4 to 29-1/4.
